notices.text: Westmeath County Council minor works close the navigable arch of Athlone Town Bridge from 17 to 24 November 2026. Follow safety boat crew instructions throughout.
notices.title: Athlone Town Bridge navigable arch closed 17-24 Nov (works)

notices.text: Repairs to Roosky Bridge are complete and the bridge is back in normal operation on winter operating hours.
notices.title: Roosky Bridge back in normal operation

notices.text: Apply and pay €63.50 online by 1 November. Power and water at public moorings off over the winter; the 5-day rule applies otherwise.
notices.title: Winter mooring 1 Nov 2026 to 31 Mar 2027

notices.text: ESB maintenance: the Ardnacrusha locks are closed from 1 October 2026 to 31 March 2027 inclusive. No transit between the Shannon and Limerick.
notices.title: Ardnacrusha locks closed to 31 March 2027

notices.text: Waterways Ireland, with partners, has launched A Boater's Guide to Fire Safety, available from the National Directorate for Fire and Emergency Management website. It advises boaters to fit and test smoke and carbon monoxide alarms, use and store LPG cylinders safely, and do a nightly fire safety check before bed.
notices.title: All Navigations: boater fire safety guide launched

notices.text: New bridge works at Hartley, between Carrick-on-Shannon and Leitrim, expected until September 2027. Pass through the centre arch only; vessels heading upstream from Carrick give way to those coming down from Leitrim; 5 km/h within 200 m of the works.
notices.title: Hartley Bridge works: centre arch only, 5 km/h

notices.text: From 1 April 2026 everyone taking part in boating at a lock, including mooring, tending lines or working gates, must wear a lifejacket or buoyancy aid while the vessel is in the lock chamber or on the lock quay walls. It applies at every Waterways Ireland lock.
notices.title: PFDs compulsory at all Waterways Ireland locks

notices.text: Sets out general navigation, safety and vessel requirements for all users. Vessels on the Shannon Navigation must be registered with Waterways Ireland, except small open undecked boats under 15 BHP on the Shannon. The notice also sets a 5 kph speed limit near infrastructure and moored vessels on the Shannon Navigation.
notices.title: Special Marine Notice 1 of 2026: general boating rules
